title: Vietnam: North-to-South Explorer
summary: Hanoi to the Mekong Delta in one trip — a night on a Ha Long Bay junk boat, Hoi An's lantern-lit old town, and progressively smaller boats the further south you go.
highlights: A night aboard a Ha Long Bay junk boat
Hanoi's old quarter by street-food crawl
The Mekong Delta by small boat

itinerary.title: Hanoi & Ha Long Bay
itinerary.description: The old quarter by foot, then an overnight junk boat in Ha Long Bay.

itinerary.title: Hue
itinerary.description: The old imperial capital and its citadel.

itinerary.title: Hoi An
itinerary.description: Lantern-lit evenings and a bicycle ride through the rice paddies.

itinerary.title: Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: War history, street food, and the city's relentless energy.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta
itinerary.description: Progressively smaller boats through the delta's floating markets.

itinerary.title: Depart
itinerary.description: A final morning before your transfer to the airport.
